title: Rosemary chickpeas with kale
summary: Rosemary chickpeas with kale is a italian dinner built around canned chickpeas in water and chopped tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Rosemary chickpeas with kale. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add canned chickpeas in water and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and chopped tomatoes.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until fresh rosemary is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Rosemary chickpeas with kale before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Rosemary chickpeas with kale.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
